Markets.title: RBI likely to hike repo rate by 25 bps to 5.50% in October policy: ET Poll
Markets.summary: Analysts surveyed by ET expect the Reserve Bank of India to raise its repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.50% during its October policy meeting. Economists view this rate hike as a necessary step to combat rising inflation driven by high crude oil costs and low agricultural production.

Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Monday
Markets.summary: Indian stock indices extended their losing streak to a fourth session due to heavy foreign institutional investor selling, surging bond yields, and elevated crude prices. This selloff erased 5 trillion rupees in market value, prompting analysts to advise long-term investors to accumulate stocks gradually.

Markets.title: Valuations of IT stocks already capture most of AI disruption risk: Chintan Haria
Markets.summary: ICICI Prudential AMC's Chintan Haria states that the Nifty IT index's 25% drop in 2026 largely prices in AI disruption risks. He highlights selective investment opportunities in firms focused on data engineering, cloud migration, legacy modernization, and AI integration.

Markets.title: RBI may hike repo rate by 25 bps as inflation and oil risks mount: Sunil Sanghai
Markets.summary: Sunil Sanghai predicts the RBI may increase the repo rate by 25 basis points in October to combat inflation and support the rupee. Strong foreign reserves and a manageable current account will serve as economic buffers during this tightening.

Markets.title: IT Q2 Preview: Muted growth, steady margins likely; deal conversion, AI deflation in focus
Markets.summary: India's leading IT firms are expected to report modest revenue growth and stable margins for the second quarter. Discretionary spending remains constrained by geopolitical issues, while AI advancements are impacting traditional services.

Markets.title: IPO bonanza: 29 companies to list this week; GMPs signal returns of up to 59%
Markets.summary: A total of 29 companies are scheduled to list on the primary market this week following a busy fundraising period. Grey market trends show mixed projections, with Vans Electroengineerings signaling potential gains of up to 59% and several other companies heading toward flat debuts.

Geo-Political.title: Kyiv bridge hit in further Russian drone attack as German chancellor makes surprise visit
Geo-Political.summary: A Russian drone struck the Pivnichyi Bridge in Kyiv, creating a large fireball as vehicles crossed. The attack occurred during a surprise visit to the city by the German chancellor.

Geo-Political.title: Watch: What we know about Russian strikes on Kyiv bridges
Geo-Political.summary: BBC Ukraine correspondent Dan Johnson reports from the scene after Kyiv's Northern Bridge was struck by Russian attacks for the second consecutive day. The ongoing strikes target critical infrastructure within the Ukrainian capital.

Geo-Political.title: Yemen's government announces all-out war to reclaim land from Houthis
Geo-Political.summary: Yemen's government has declared an all-out war to reclaim territory currently controlled by Houthi forces. This announcement coincides with ongoing airstrikes exchanged between the Houthis and the Saudi-led coalition.

Geo-Political.title: Brazil election goes to run-off as right-wing Flávio Bolsonaro wins first round
Geo-Political.summary: Because neither candidate secured more than 50% of the vote in the first round, Brazil's presidential election will proceed to a run-off. Right-wing candidate Flávio Bolsonaro won the first round and will compete in the October 25 election.

Geo-Political.title: Ethiopian rebel forces withdraw from Tigray regional capital
Geo-Political.summary: Ethiopian rebel forces have withdrawn from Mekelle, the regional capital of Tigray. Pro-government forces have now taken control of the city, according to local residents.

Geo-Political.title: Christa Pike's prognosis still unclear after failed execution, lawyer says
Geo-Political.summary: Christa Pike's lawyer stated that her prognosis remains unclear following a failed execution attempt. Doctors are currently working to clear two lethal doses of pentobarbital from her body.

Data & Insights.title: RBI rate hikes back on the table as inflation risks mount
Data & Insights.summary: Most economists surveyed by Mint predict the Monetary Policy Committee will raise the key repo rate to 5.50% on October 7 due to mounting inflation risks. Only one of the ten surveyed experts expects the central bank to pause rate hikes.

Data & Insights.title: The oil shock hasn’t stopped the factory boom. It may be changing what factories make | Explained
Data & Insights.summary: Despite rising energy costs and factory selling prices, manufacturers continue to expand their operations. High oil prices may be shifting the types of products these factories are making.

Data & Insights.title: RBI likely to raise repo rate in October 2026 as West Asia crisis fuels inflation risks
Data & Insights.summary: Experts polled predict the Reserve Bank of India will raise the repo rate by 0.25 percentage points during its October 2026 policy meeting. This anticipated rate hike is driven by rising inflation risks stemming from the ongoing West Asia crisis.

Data & Insights.title: GST arrest powers may be removed? Council to discuss decriminalisation on Wednesday; law change likely in Winter Session
Data & Insights.summary: The Centre and states are discussing removing arrest powers under the GST indirect tax regime due to concerns over how these provisions are used against businesses. The GST Council will discuss this potential decriminalisation on Wednesday, with a law change likely during the upcoming Winter Session.

Data & Insights.title: Easy money era is ending, interest rates to stay high: French economist Landau
Data & Insights.summary: French economist Jean-Pierre Landau warns that real interest rates will remain structurally high. This trend is driven by falling savings, increasing investment needs, and heavy public debt.

Data & Insights.title: India’s food market: $600 bn estimate; 7% CAGR — from primary producer to high-value global processing powerhouse
Data & Insights.summary: India's $600 billion food market is growing at a 7% CAGR as the country transitions into a high-value global processing powerhouse. This shift aims to more than double current agricultural exports of $53 billion through increased value addition and new market access from the India–EU Free Trade Agreement.

India.title: Single-Use Plastic Bottles Banned At Delhi's Sports Complexes
India.summary: Delhi's sports complexes have banned single-use plastic bottles as part of the Delhi Development Authority's cleanliness drive. Water dispensers and separate bins for wet and dry waste have been installed to support this initiative.

India.title: 'LoRa' A New Security Challenge In Kashmir: Terrorists Using Advanced Tech
India.summary: Security agencies in Kashmir discovered that Pakistani terror commanders are using advanced off-grid LoRa handsets. This technology shift presents a new security challenge for authorities in the region.

India.title: In Assam's Dhemaji, Grazing Land Being Developed As Village Forest
India.summary: A grazing land in Assam's Dhemaji is being developed into the proposed Maguwahola Village Forest. This project is a collaborative effort between the Dhemaji district administration and the Forest Department.

India.title: Human Rights Body Action Over Minors' Participation At Mumbai CJP Protest
India.summary: India's human rights commission issued notices regarding the participation of minors at a Mumbai protest. The body demanded action taken reports within a week from local police, government ministries, X Corp., and the state's child development department.

India.title: Adani Group, Kachchh University Launch Green Energy Centre Of Excellence
India.summary: Gujarat Governor Acharya Devvrat inaugurated a new Green Energy Centre of Excellence, established by the Adani Group and Kachchh University. The facility will provide specialized training in renewable energy technologies and industrial automation to over 10,000 students annually.

India.title: Cross-Border Arms Network Busted In Punjab, AK-47, Grenades Seized
India.summary: Punjab police arrested Navjot Singh from Tarn Taran district after intercepting him on a motorcycle. Authorities seized weapons including an AK-47 and grenades from the cross-border arms network suspect.

General.title: US removes all bombers from RAF Fairford base
General.summary: The United States military has removed all bombers from the RAF Fairford air base in the UK. These aircraft have now been sent back to their home stations in the United States.

General.title: Brazil election goes to run-off as right-wing Flávio Bolsonaro wins first round
General.summary: Neither candidate secured more than 50% of the vote in the first round of Brazil's election, forcing a run-off. Right-wing candidate Flávio Bolsonaro won this initial round, and the final decision will take place on October 25.

General.title: Green Party members back 'Zionism is racism' motion
